'''Brohmer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi instructor|combat instructor]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A dark-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] with [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], Brohmer wore brown and tan [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] and carried a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Brohmer was stationed at the [[Republic Operational Headquarters|Republic Operations Center]], a [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]], and he wore a [[Rebreather/Legends|rebreather]] in order to protect himself against the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], which was rendered toxic by the presence of large amounts of chemicals such as [[Venenit queshaaga|Quesh venom]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Brohmer first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], as a trainer for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class on the planet Quesh,<ref name="TOR" /> and he received a mention in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'' that was released concurrently with the game.<ref name="Prima">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
